capex.source: ESEF ifrs-full:PurchaseOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentClassifiedAsInvestingActivities (PP&E only; may exclude intangibles/capitalised R&D)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 5.2% and FY2024 6.3% (from filed revenue); data-center/electrification demand supports mid-to-high single digit, fading toward GDP-plus

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 6699/40152 = 16.7% (filed), held flat

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. French statutory rate 25.8%; FY2025 pretax 6,180 vs net income 4,163 implies higher effective rate incl. minorities/associates, so 25% is a simplification

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: D&A not found in filing data; set at 3.0% of revenue as placeholder, reviewer to replace from the annual report cash flow statement

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM Ke = Rf 3.27% (ECB AAA 10Y, 2026-11-05) + beta 1.0 (assumed, not looked up) x France ERP 5.01% (Damodaran, 2026-02-16) = 8.3%; pre-tax Kd ~4% assumed, after-tax ~3%; weights ~85/15 equity/debt gives ~7.7%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: slightly below long-run nominal growth; below the 3.27% EUR 10Y risk-free rate

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = borrowings_noncurrent 15,021 - cash 4,634 (ESEF 969500A1YF1XUYYXS284-2025-12-31-ESEF-FR-0); current borrowings not reported in the data, so net debt may be understated

diluted_shares.source: Derived: FY2025 net income attributable 4,163m / diluted EPS 7.33 (ESEF ifrs-full:DilutedEarningsLossPerShare); weighted diluted share count not directly reported by tool
